hints.title: Divisibility Rule of Three
hints.text: A number is divisible by 3 if and only if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3.

hints.title: Group Digits by Modulo 3
hints.text: Partition digits into three buckets based on d % 3 (mod 0, mod 1, mod 2).

hints.title: Remove Minimal Digits
hints.text: If sum % 3 == 1, remove smallest mod 1 digit, or if none, two smallest mod 2 digits. Symmetrically for sum % 3 == 2.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Combinatorial subset testing takes exponential time 2^N.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy minimal deletion by digit modulo eliminates at most 2 digits, running in O(N log N) sorting time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies the sum-of-digits modulo rule and removes smallest candidates first.
complexity.notes: Leading zero edge case: multiple zeros should return single "0".
